::: {.book-summary} ## Book Summary Insight Leviticus teaches how a holy God can dwell among His covenant people through sacrifice, priesthood, worship, and holy living. The recurring theme is found throughout the book: "Be holy, for I am holy." (Leviticus 11:44; 19:2; 20:26). ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 1
Leviticus 1:3
Burnt offering without blemish
### Why This Verse Defines acceptable sacrifice ### Chapter Insight This chapter introduces the burnt offering as an act of complete dedication to God. The key verse emphasizes worship through voluntary sacrifice and atonement. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 2
Leviticus 2:13
Salt of the covenant
### Why This Verse Frequently cited covenant symbol ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes the grain offering as an expression of gratitude and devotion. The key verse highlights offering the best of one's labor to God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 3
Leviticus 3:17
Neither fat nor blood
### Why This Verse Permanent ordinance emphasis ### Chapter Insight This chapter explains the fellowship (peace) offering. The key verse emphasizes reconciliation and communion with God through sacrifice. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 4
Leviticus 4:35
Atonement shall be made
### Why This Verse Central sin-offering theme ### Chapter Insight This chapter establishes procedures for sin offerings. The key verse demonstrates God's provision for dealing with unintentional sin. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 5
Leviticus 5:5
Confess the sin committed
### Why This Verse Foundational confession text ### Chapter Insight This chapter continues instructions concerning sin and guilt offerings. The key verse stresses confession and accountability before God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 6
Leviticus 6:13
Fire shall never go out
### Why This Verse One of Leviticus' most quoted verses ### Chapter Insight This chapter provides further regulations for offerings and priestly duties. The key verse emphasizes continual devotion symbolized by the ever-burning fire. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 7
Leviticus 7:37
Law of the offerings
### Why This Verse Summary of sacrificial system ### Chapter Insight This chapter concludes the laws regarding sacrifices. The key verse underscores the holiness of worship and proper participation in sacred offerings. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 8
Leviticus 8:33
Seven days of consecration
### Why This Verse Priesthood inauguration emphasis ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the consecration of Aaron and his sons as priests. The key verse highlights obedience to God's appointed process for ministry. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 9
Leviticus 9:24
Fire came from before the LORD
### Why This Verse Divine acceptance of worship ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes the beginning of priestly service and God's acceptance of the offerings. The key verse marks God's visible approval through His glory. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 10
Leviticus 10:3
I will be sanctified in them that come near Me
### Why This Verse Holiness principle ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the judgment of Nadab and Abihu for unauthorized worship. The key verse teaches the seriousness of approaching God with reverence. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 11
Leviticus 11:44
Be holy, for I am holy
### Why This Verse Major biblical holiness text ### Chapter Insight This chapter establishes dietary laws distinguishing clean and unclean animals. The key verse connects holiness with daily living and obedience. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 12
Leviticus 12:8
Provision for the poor
### Why This Verse Frequently noted sacrificial exception ### Chapter Insight This chapter provides purification regulations after childbirth. The key verse emphasizes ceremonial cleansing and restoration to worship. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 13
Leviticus 13:45
Unclean person isolated
### Why This Verse Most recognized leprosy regulation ### Chapter Insight This chapter outlines laws concerning skin diseases and ceremonial uncleanness. The key verse highlights the need to identify and address impurity. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 14
Leviticus 14:57
To teach when it is clean or unclean
### Why This Verse Purpose statement ### Chapter Insight This chapter explains the cleansing of those healed from leprosy. The key verse demonstrates God's provision for restoration and reintegration. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 15
Leviticus 15:31
Separate from uncleanness
### Why This Verse Summary principle ### Chapter Insight This chapter addresses bodily discharges and ceremonial purity. The key verse reinforces the importance of holiness before God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 16
Leviticus 16:30
On this day atonement shall be made
### Why This Verse Central Day of Atonement verse ### Chapter Insight This chapter establishes the Day of Atonement. The key verse presents the central annual act of atonement for Israel's sins. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 17
Leviticus 17:11
Life of the flesh is in the blood
### Why This Verse Foundational atonement theology ### Chapter Insight This chapter regulates sacrifices and the sanctity of blood. The key verse teaches that life is in the blood and that atonement comes through sacrifice. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 18
Leviticus 18:22
Thou shalt not lie with mankind
### Why This Verse Most cited verse in chapter ### Chapter Insight This chapter prohibits immoral sexual practices. The key verse calls God's people to distinct holiness from surrounding nations. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 19
Leviticus 19:18
Love thy neighbor as thyself
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted verses in the Bible ### Chapter Insight This chapter applies holiness to everyday relationships and conduct. The key verse summarizes the chapter's ethical teaching through love of neighbor. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 20
Leviticus 20:26
Be holy unto Me
### Why This Verse Covenant holiness ### Chapter Insight This chapter outlines penalties for serious sins and idolatry. The key verse emphasizes God's call for His people to be holy. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 21
Leviticus 21:8
He shall be holy unto thee
### Why This Verse Priestly holiness ### Chapter Insight This chapter sets standards for priestly holiness. The key verse highlights the priest's unique responsibility to represent God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 22
Leviticus 22:31
Keep My commandments and do them
### Why This Verse Obedience emphasis ### Chapter Insight This chapter regulates the handling of holy offerings. The key verse stresses reverence for God's holy name. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 23
Leviticus 23:3
Sabbath of solemn rest
### Why This Verse Foundation of sacred calendar ### Chapter Insight This chapter establishes Israel's sacred feasts and appointed times. The key verse emphasizes worship through remembrance of God's works. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 24
Leviticus 24:22
One law for stranger and native
### Why This Verse Equality before the law ### Chapter Insight This chapter addresses worship practices and justice within the community. The key verse presents the principle of equal justice and accountability. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 25
Leviticus 25:10
Proclaim liberty throughout the land
### Why This Verse Famous Jubilee verse (on the Liberty Bell) ### Chapter Insight This chapter introduces the Sabbath Year and Year of Jubilee. The key verse teaches that the land and people ultimately belong to God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 26
Leviticus 26:12
I will walk among you and be your God
### Why This Verse Covenant blessing climax ### Chapter Insight This chapter presents blessings for obedience and consequences for disobedience. The key verse expresses God's desire to dwell among His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 27
Leviticus 27:30
The tithe is the LORD's
### Why This Verse Most cited verse on tithing in the chapter ### Chapter Insight This chapter concludes Leviticus with laws concerning vows and dedications. The key verse emphasizes honoring commitments made to God. :::
